correctness.rationale: Six antipodal vertex-normal great circles have all 20 triple determinants nonzero in \(\mathbb Q(\sqrt5)\), yielding exactly 32 cells; 12 exact vertex-ray signs produce 10 crossings and 20 exact facet rays produce 12. Inner sign chamber and outer Voronoi cell are regular spherical pentagons whose nested midpoint incidences were checked symbolically. Spherical right-triangle trigonometry and analytic integration of the five disjoint side segments give exact joint cap areas for every real threshold; the independent quadrature and simulation are only corroboration.
